item.title: BO - Hall of Fame - Community Heroes
item.description: BO - Hall of Fame - Community Heroes Details Component : Core Status : Automated Automated on : 9.2.x, 9.3.x Scenario : https://prestashop-jira.atlassian.net/browse/TEST-8546 Test : https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/tree/develop/tests/UI/campaigns/functional/BO/16_wallOfFame/01_OurCommunity.ts Steps Step Description Expected result BO > Wall of Fame Wall of fame displayed h1. “MEET our community Heroes From day one, PrestaShop has thrived as an open-source platform powered by a talented community of developers, merchants, and contributors. We all work together to improve and support the scalability of the PrestaShop e-commerce platform.
